name: Direction Aware Cube
description: Grid of square image tiles that flip like a cube toward the edge the cursor enters or leaves from, revealing the item title on the hidden face.
contents: Grid of square image tiles, each with a grayscale-blended image on the front
Back face with title and two-digit index number
behavior: Hover direction is detected from the entering or leaving edge (top, right, bottom, left)
Tile rotates in 3D around that edge to show the back face and rotates back on leave
Tile positions are re-measured on window resize
editableByProps: Tile images and titles, number of tiles
Tile size, gap, column count, flip duration, easing and perspective
Background, front gradient, back face background, title color, font and size

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the index number style on the back face

fixed: Loads Cormorant Garamond and DM Sans through a Google Fonts @import inside the component style block
